Hello,

I saw your opening for a Web Designer at Data Eminence and was drawn to your focus on bridging strong visual communication with functional, responsive digital experiences.

At AT Creation, I worked directly with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoffs, translating wireframes and prototypes into clean interface designs while managing branding assets.

My Bounceless case study demonstrates this same approach to B2B UX problem solving and interface design, which you can see on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur and ready to relocate for this role. Could we take a brief look at one case study together next week?

Ananya

Hello,

I am applying for the Media & Graphics Design Associate role at Accenture to help drive your digital marketing ads and content operations at scale.

During my time at Ascent Business Solutions, I have produced over one hundred digital and print creatives, including marketing collateral and presentations, while building reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time for corporate communications.

My social campaign for a fashion brand, which demonstrated a fifteen percent increase in follower engagement, highlights my execution of marketing assets and is available on my portfolio at https://ananya-portfolio-nu.vercel.app/.

I am currently based in Nagpur, fully prepared to relocate to Mumbai, and would welcome a brief conversation.

Ananya
